title: CI Agent Regression Harness results
description: Suite-level verdict file. Scenario entries are diagnostics and are not pass/block decisions. Version 1 is the original file. Version 2.0.0 (any 2.x.y string) adds an optional one-sentence caption on each scenario and arm, and an optional model_id on each arm. Version 2.1.0 adds optional schema_version, verdicts.overall.model_ids for the baseline and candidate, and optional gate settings copied from suite.yaml. Decimals such as 0.05 and amounts such as $1.25 are valid caption text. A model id is recorded text such as gemini-3.5-flash-lite and does not change the suite verdict. When verdicts.overall.model_ids is present it is preferred over the per-arm model_id. Gate settings do not change Pass, Block, Insufficient evidence, or Invalid run. Extra fields are allowed so a real results.json can be dropped in at data/results.preliminary.json.

version.description: 1, or a 2.x.y schema version such as 2.0.0 or 2.1.0. Other major versions are not supported. Omitted only when schema_version is a 2.x.y string.

schema_version.description: Optional copy of the 2.x.y schema tag. On a 2.1.0 file this is "2.1.0". When both version and schema_version are set they match. Not used on version 1.

verdicts.description: Optional suite detail. model_ids here are preferred over arms.*.model_id when present. They do not change the suite status.

baseline.description: Baseline model id, for example gemini-2.5-flash-lite-001.

candidate.description: Candidate model id, for example gemini-3.5-flash-lite.

gate.description: Optional gate settings copied from suite.yaml. Harness PR #13 was not readable when this schema was written, so these key names are the optional contract: delta, alpha, min_valid, ci_level, miss_cap. The same keys are also accepted at the top level of the file when gate is omitted. Missing settings display as δ = 5 pp / 90%. They do not change the suite status.

caption.description: Optional one-sentence caption. Digits, decimals such as 0.05, and amounts such as $1.25 are valid text.

model_id.description: Optional model id recorded for this arm. Shown when present. It does not change the suite verdict.
